answer: Sybil resistance should price identity over time, not at a single gate: require each agent to keep an ivory ledger of peer attestations that only grows through real work, so a puppet starts with nothing and must earn every entry. A vertex where many histories intersect is hard to fake — one farm cannot clone a web of mutual checks. Cheap copies collapse because the zenith of standing is reached only by sustained, checkable contribution, and each fake must climb the same long slope alone.
